## CytoTRACE
```{r}
tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
tar_load(cytotrace_hsc)
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- Seurat::AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, 
                                         cytotrace_hsc)
```

```{r}
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data %>% 
  mutate(clust = sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.5) %>% 
  group_by(clust)%>%
  mutate(preKNN_CytoTRACE2_Score_clust_scale = (preKNN_CytoTRACE2_Score-min(preKNN_CytoTRACE2_Score))/(max(preKNN_CytoTRACE2_Score)-min(preKNN_CytoTRACE2_Score)) ) %>%
  ungroup()%>%
  ggplot(aes(clust, preKNN_CytoTRACE2_Score_clust_scale, fill = sample.name))+
  geom_boxplot(position = position_dodge())
```

```{r}
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, names(cytotrace_hsc)[sapply(cytotrace_hsc,is.double)]) %>% 
  patchwork::wrap_plots()&
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&RestoreLegend()

DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,label = TRUE,label.size = 5)
VlnPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,features = "CytoTRACE2_Relative",split.by = "sample.name")
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$seurat_clusters <- as.character(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$seurat_clusters)
l <- lapply(unique(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$seurat_clusters),function(clust)
  VlnPlot(subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, seurat_clusters %in% clust),
                                    features = "CytoTRACE2_Relative",
                                    group.by = "sample.name")+
    ggtitle(clust))
names(l) <- unique(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$seurat_clusters)

DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,group.by = names(cytotrace_hsc)[!sapply(cytotrace_hsc,is.double)])
DimPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,group.by = "sample.name", split.by = "CytoTRACE2_Potency")

```

```{r}
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data %>% 
    mutate(clust = factor(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9)) %>% 
    group_by(sample.name, clust)%>%
    summarize(med = mean(preKNN_CytoTRACE2_Score) ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = sample.name, values_from = med) %>% mutate(grp =  `HSC_Het_CD41+mCh+` > `HSC_WT_CD41+`)%>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(`HSC_Het_CD41+mCh+`, `HSC_Het_CD41+mCh-`,`HSC_WT_CD41+` ),names_to = "sample.name",values_to = "med")%>%
    mutate(sample.name = factor(sample.name,levels = c("HSC_WT_CD41+","HSC_Het_CD41+mCh-", "HSC_Het_CD41+mCh+" )))%>%
  
    ggplot(aes(sample.name, med,group = clust,color = clust))+
  geom_point()+geom_line()+facet_wrap(~grp,ncol = 1)
```


## SCENT
```{r}
tar_load(scent_scores_hsc)
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$scentscore <- scent_scores_hsc[rownames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@meta.data),"scaled_potency"]
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,"scentscore",
            split.by = "sample.name",
            combine = FALSE) %>% 
  patchwork::wrap_plots()&
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo",limits = c(0,1))
FeatureScatter(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, "scentscore", "nFeature_RNA",group.by = "sample.name")
DefaultAssay(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc) <- "RNA"
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- NormalizeData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
```

```{r}
get_scent_potency <- function(srt_obj, scent_net) {

  # Match network genes to Seurat object
  genes_in_srt <- rownames(srt_obj@assays$SCT@data)
  mouse_to_human <- map_ortho_gene(genes_in_srt)
  human_shared <- intersect(rownames(scent_net),names(mouse_to_human))
  mouse_shared <- mouse_to_human[human_shared]

  # Subset to shared genes
  net_filtered <- scent_net[human_shared, human_shared]
  rm(scent_net);gc()
  expr_mat     <- as.matrix(srt_obj@assays$SCT@data[mouse_shared,])
  rownames(expr_mat) <- human_shared

  # Run CCAT
  potency_scores <- SCENT::CompCCAT(expr_mat, net_filtered)

  # Return data.frame
  data.frame(
    cell.name      = colnames(expr_mat),
    potency        = potency_scores,
    scaled_potency = potency_scores / max(potency_scores),
    row.names      = colnames(expr_mat)
  )
}

library(SCENT)
data(dataLiver)
dim(scLiver.m)

ccat.v <- CompCCAT(exp = scLiver.m, ppiA = net13Jun12.m)
boxplot(ccat.v ~ names(phenoLiver.v),xlab="Embryonic stages",ylab="CCAT",col=colorLiver.v)

ccat.v$nfeats <- colSums(scLiver.m>1) 

```
